_about: Golden relevance set for startup search. Each case is an investor-vocabulary QUERY and the set of company domains that a human agrees are relevant and SHOULD appear in the top results. `thin` marks companies whose own one-liner uses different words than the query — the vocabulary-gap cases query expansion is meant to rescue. Non-thin entries are regression controls. All domains verified present in the prod corpus 2026-09-14. Metric: recall@K and mean-reciprocal-rank of the expected set. Grow this set; do not prune a case just because it fails.

Every match is thin by construction (no shared vocabulary): scale ('infrastructure to accelerate AI'), replicate ('Run ML models in cloud'), daft ('AI data engine'), lancedb (vectordb), sf-tensor ('Infrastructure for AI labs'), withmetis ('Infrastructure to build reliable agents').
